Historical archive / forensic re-audit

VARZIN 2025.
Preserved, re-tested,
and reclassified.

This page audits the pre-correction 2025 VARZIN archive against its own released files. It preserves provenance while separating computational artifacts from claims that do not survive reproducibility, statistical, or evidential review.

18 Zenodo records reviewedSource packages re-extractedSeptember 2026 re-audit
Audit rule

Historical publication is not treated as validation. Claims are retained as records, but current scientific status is assigned from the released data, code, methods, and reproducibility artifacts—not from titles, declarations, or symbolic framing.

01 / headline findings

Several strong 2025 claims do not survive direct re-analysis.

QMSG

Raw-data significance disappears

The released QMSG CSV contains observed counts [19, 12, 23]. Under the report's 5:4:5 null proportions, the correct chi-square test is χ² = 1.4815, df = 2, p = 0.47676. The later report multiplied the counts by 10 to [190, 120, 230] without adding independent observations; that alone multiplies χ² by 10 and creates artificial significance. The published “statistically proven non-random” conclusion is therefore rejected.

ETFM

Torus fit is not exceptional under a null

The Phase-1 reproducibility pack reports R0 = 0.400, R1 = 0.705, RMS = 0.1426647, while the narrative report gives different parameters (R0 = 0.708, R1 = 0.654, RMS = 0.129). A 2,000,000-draw random-sphere null using the same 12-node/axis convention found 32.8% of random sets fit at least as well as RMS 0.1426647; the 0.15 threshold was passed by about 38.3% of null sets. This is not evidence for a privileged planetary torus.

SETI / audio

Key frequencies were generated by construction

The released Python generator explicitly synthesizes chirps from 144→474 Hz and 474→777 Hz. A spectrogram showing those bands is therefore an expected property of the generated signal, not independent evidence of an external field response.

Genomics

No genomic measurement layer is present

The re-extracted 2025 archive contains no FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/SAM, VCF or BED data. The genomic-mirror report describes tone exposure, subjective somatic feedback and symbolic chromosome assignments, but no sequencing or molecular assay capable of establishing genomic activation.

02 / mathematical claims

Symbolic reformulation is not a proof of an open problem.

P versus NP record: the 2025 HTML “proof” assumes the existence of a polynomial-time function g that agrees with an arbitrary NP-class function f, then concludes P = NP. That assumption contains the substance that must be proved. Five subset-sum demonstrations do not establish the universal complexity-class result. The P = NP claim is rejected; the document is retained only as historical provenance.

Standard torus parameterization, affine arithmetic, Fourier/spectrogram calculations, checksums and descriptive tabulation can still be mathematically or computationally valid in isolation. They do not imply the historical physical, biological or consciousness-field interpretations attached to them.

03 / what remains useful

Not everything in the archive is scientifically empty.

Retain as useful artifacts

  • LUXVAR as a constructed symbolic/language artifact.
  • Descriptive calendar counts, transition tables and run-length summaries, when described as properties of the constructed dataset.
  • ETFM geometry as a visualization/computational exercise, not a physical-field confirmation.
  • Checksums, manifests and provenance bundles.
  • Audio synthesis and spectrogram code as signal-processing demonstrations.
  • Historical documents as a case study in human–AI epistemic feedback and later self-correction.

Do not treat as established evidence

  • External consciousness fields or “field communication.”
  • Frequency-driven biological or genomic activation.
  • Planetary torus consciousness or predictive geophysics.
  • Proofs of P = NP or other unsolved physics/mathematics from symbolic field logic.
  • QMSG non-randomness based on the released scaled-count analysis.
  • Historical-cycle predictions framed as harmonic causation.

05 / interpretation policy

The archive stays visible, but it no longer controls current claims.

These findings do not erase the 2025 record. They change its evidential status. VARZIN's current scientific position is governed by the later audited computational work, version-matched artifacts, explicit negative results, and falsification-oriented tests. Historical records remain useful for provenance, research-integrity analysis, and study of long-form human–AI co-construction.
